projects.title: SoundCloud
projects.summary: Developed and shipped monetization products including new ad products and SoundCloud Go and Go+
projects.imageAlt: The SoundCloud app on two phones

layers.title: What you see
layers.note: I built new ad products in the listening feed and the SoundCloud Go/Go+ screens. Go/Go+ opened a new revenue stream for the company.

layers.title: The app
layers.note: I was the main iOS developer on SoundCloud Go, building the UI and payment infrastructure. I also led the modularization of the Monetization codebase.

layers.title: The services
layers.note: Scala backend for the feed ads, for high throughput and scalability.

projects.title: Noggin
projects.summary: Developed and launched a first-to-market subscription streaming service for Nickelodeon revitalizing the Noggin brand
projects.imageAlt: The Noggin app on a tablet, with mascots peeking over the top

layers.title: What you see
layers.note: A subscription-based product that took Nickelodeon's brand direct to consumers for the first time.

layers.title: The app
layers.note: An iOS app built around its UI. I built the Moose and Zee animations, which react to fast swiping or long idle time. I also added themed parallax to the episode lists for the shows in the home screen's infinite carousel, plus a few UIKit Dynamics touches.

projects.title: NBCUniversal
projects.summary: Developed the mobile apps and backend for several NBCU brands including, but not limited to, USA, SyFy, Bravo, E!, and Telemundo
projects.imageAlt: The USA Network app on a phone and the Bravo Now app on a tablet

layers.title: The app
layers.note: Modernization of the tech stack using the latest iOS APIs/SDKs. I led the Apple SSO integration across nine brand products amongst other brand-specific improvements.

layers.title: The services
layers.note: I built Backend for Frontends for the platform. They cut the impact of third-party downtime and took recovery from days to hours.

layers.title: The infrastructure
layers.note: Automation of AWS deployments (Infrastructure as Code) and added Pact contract tests, which made releases faster and safer. I also worked on the move from AWS to Google Cloud and Kubernetes.

projects.title: Peachi
projects.summary: First of its kind fashion marketplace utilizing a user's unique style profile to provide outfit inspiration and inspired shopping
projects.imageAlt: The Peachi app on two phones

layers.title: What you see
layers.note: An AI stylist that recommends outfits for your personal style, built in React Native (Expo).

layers.title: The app
layers.note: I co-founded Peachi as CTO and led the app, including its "Find your style" onboarding. The Sizing Calculator, from the NYC Antler accelerator, gave a 27% uptick in organic sign-ups and a 4% purchase conversion in under a week.

layers.title: The services
layers.note: A recommendation engine picks the outfits, and it runs on a Python (Flask) backend.
